items.title: [SF-A05-B01] conv.u8 sign-extends an int32 stack value instead of zero-extending
items.deliverable: CilVirtualMachine.prototype.convert('conv.u8', -1) returns -1n (0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF); ECMA-335 III.3.27 requires zero extension so (ulong)uint.MaxValue and (long)uintValue are wrong. Cause: cil-vm.js:173-177 takes BigInt(raw) of the signed number then asUintN(64) without first masking a 32-bit source when target is u8/u.
items.acceptance:
- [ ] uint x = 0xFFFFFFFF; Console.WriteLine((ulong)x) prints 4294967295 in the CIL engine; regression test added.

- [ ] Regression test reproduces the defect before the fix and passes after.
items.status: implemented and validated; PR #1448, CI passed

items.title: [SF-A05-B02] Unchecked double-to-Int64/UInt64 conversion wraps modulo 2^64 instead of saturating
items.deliverable: convert('conv.i8', 1e30) returns 5076964154930102272n because cil-vm.js:177 applies BigInt.asIntN to the truncated value; only the i4 path has a deterministic out-of-range result (line 176). .NET saturates (long.MaxValue) on .NET 9+ and returned 0x8000000000000000 before; conv.u4 of 3e9 also returns -1294967296 inconsistent with documented policy.
items.acceptance:
- [ ] Out-of-range float to i8/u8/u4/i2/i1 conversions follow one documented .NET-compatible table and are covered by fixtures.

- [ ] Regression test reproduces the defect before the fix and passes after.
items.status: implemented and validated; PR #1448, CI passed

items.title: [SF-A05-B04] Runtime-raised faults are not caught by typed catch clauses other than System.Exception
items.deliverable: matches() (cil-vm.js:90-94) treats records of kind 'exception' as matching only when systemType(r.type)===target or target is System.Exception; runtime faults are allocated with unqualified names like 'DivideByZeroException' (raise(), cil-vm.js:240) so catch(DivideByZeroException) [System.DivideByZeroException] and catch(ArithmeticException) never match. Found by code reading; reachable only with externally compiled (Roslyn) assemblies because the in-repo compiler rejects exception types other than Exception (CS0246).
items.acceptance:
- [ ] try{int z=0;int y=1/z;}catch(DivideByZeroException){Console.WriteLine("ok");} from a Roslyn-compiled fixture DLL prints ok in the CIL engine.

- [ ] Regression test reproduces the defect before the fix and passes after.

items.title: [SF-A05-B03] callvirt override lookup ignores newslot/hiding and explicit MethodImpl
items.deliverable: cil-vm.js:226 walks from the runtime type up the base chain picking the first method with the same name and signature, so a 'new virtual' method in a derived class is called through a base-typed reference where .NET calls the base slot. Cause: no vtable slots, name matching only. Found by code reading; not reproduced at runtime.
